segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ קָנֶה שֶׁל זֵיתִים, אִם יֵשׁ קֶשֶׁר בְּרֹאשׁוֹ — מְקַבֵּל טוּמְאָה, וְאִם לָאו — אֵין מְקַבֵּל טוּמְאָה. בֵּין כָּךְ וּבֵין כָּךְ — נִיטָּל בַּשַּׁבָּת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A reed» that is used «for» turning «olives» in a bundle, «if there is a» cork-like «knot at the top of it,» it «can become ritually impure» as a vessel, «and if not,» it «cannot become ritually impure,» because it is not a vessel. «In either case, it may be moved on Shabbat» for use in a permitted action.

moves.summary: rules on the olive reed's impurity and Shabbat status

positions.claim: with a knot it contracts impurity, without not; either way it may be moved on Shabbat
